title: Obi-Wan vs. Jango Fett
front_description: After receiving orders from the Jedi Council, Obi-Wan Kenobi sets out to capture Jango Fett, who may be the key to the curious mystery of the secretly-commissioned clone troopers. But the wary Fett isn't captured so easilv. About to leave Tipoca City in their spaceship, Jango and son Boba are suddenly confronted by Obi-Wan, and a spectacular, rain-swept battle ensues atop the spaceport landing platform.
back_description: Nefarious bounty hunter Jango Fett is prepared for the Episode II cameras
